If you genuinely cannot stand to look at your stepfather’s face for long (whether due to past conflicts, discomfort, or personal reasons), excluding him was not inherently wrong. Art is subjective, and your choice reflects your emotional truth, not necessarily a lack of respect. 2. **The Stepfather’s Reaction** – His response was disproportionate and childish. I made my choice, and I stand by it.”* - **Talk to Your Mom Privately:** If she’s truly open to it, explain how much this painting meant to you and why his presence (or absence) felt right.
